title: Keep availability checks in one place
context: Separate availability checks let two neighbors reserve the same item at once.
decision: LoanService owns item reservations. Every borrowing request and return uses the same availability rules before changing item state.

alternatives.name: Check availability in each screen
alternatives.reason: Rejected: separate screens could disagree or change at the same time.

alternatives.name: Let owners resolve double bookings manually
alternatives.reason: Rejected: creates avoidable frustration for owners and borrowers.
